'''Janton Belos'''<ref name="Light and Dark">"[[Light and Dark (adventure)|Light and Dark]]"</ref> was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individual who served the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] during the [[Golden Age of the Sith]]. Belos attained a position as a minor [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and took<ref name="Child of Light" /> the [[Near-Human]]<ref name="Light and Dark" /> [[Valik Kodank]] as his consort. In an effort to keep her contented and romantically interested in him, he [[Sith training|trained]] Kodank in the ways of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. Kodank grew in power and concealed her new strength from Belos; without his knowledge, she took another Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] as her lover and founded a [[Sith cult/Legends|sect]] of her own followers.<ref name="Child of Light" />

==Behind the scenes==
Janton Belos<ref name="Light and Dark" /> was first mentioned as an unnamed Sith Lord in ''[[Child of Light]]'', a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure written by [[Lee Pickler]] and published by [[RPGA]] in [[2000]] as the opening instalment of the [[Child of Light saga|''Child of Light'' saga]].<ref name="Child of Light" /> He was subsequently mentioned in the third ''Child of Light'' saga adventure, [[Light and Dark (adventure)|''Light and Dark'']], in [[2002]], which identified his name.<ref name="Light and Dark" /> Neither adventure specifies Belos' [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Child of Light" /><ref name="Light and Dark" />
